units.title: 不宜丘墓同宫、安可雷风合卦：三丘五墓二杀俱动病人作福也难留；雷风是棺椁杀——震为棺、巽为椁、坤为墓、艮为冢，占病若全必死

rule.yi: 不适宜丘墓在同一宫，怎么能雷风合成一卦？注说：三丘、五墓都见后面。这两个煞一起发动，病人做福也留不住；雷风是棺椁杀，震是棺，巽是椁，坤是墓，艮是冢，占病如果都齐了，必死。
rule.en: It is not fitting for the Mounds and Tombs to be in the same palace; how can Thunder and Wind combine in one hexagram? The commentary says: the Three Mounds and Five Tombs are all given later. When the two killings move together, even if the sick person performs blessing rites he can hardly be kept; Thunder and Wind are the Coffin-and-Outer-Coffin killing, Zhen being the coffin, Xun the outer coffin, Kun the grave and Gen the tomb mound; if in divining an illness all are present, he surely dies.

yi: 不适宜丘墓在同一宫，
怎么能让雷风合成一卦？
en: It is not fitting for the Mounds and Tombs to be in the same palace;
how can Thunder and Wind combine in one hexagram?

yi: 三丘、五墓，
都见后面。
en: The Three Mounds and Five Tombs:
all are given later.

yi: 这两个煞一起发动，
病人做福也难留。
雷和风这两卦，
是棺椁杀。
震卦是棺，
巽卦是椁，
坤卦是墓，
艮卦是冢。
占病如果都齐了，必死。
en: When the two killings move together,
even if the sick person performs blessing rites he can hardly be kept.
Thunder and Wind
are the Coffin-and-Outer-Coffin killing.
Zhen is the coffin,
Xun is the outer coffin,
Kun is the grave,
Gen is the tomb mound.
If in divining an illness all are present, he surely dies.

note.yi: 「二杀」是三丘和五墓，书里说「俱见后」——后面的凶煞章。三丘五墓的排法（春丑夏辰秋未冬戌为三丘，对宫取五墓）见易林补遗「总论星煞值鬼诀」（LY.ILL.EL.51），「病人作福也难留」一句同是那首歌诀里的原话。「雷风」指震（雷）、巽（风）两卦：震为棺、巽为椁，和易冒、增删卜易里「风雷合卦、棺椁俱全」（LY.ILL.ZS.15）是同一个说法。「占病若全必死」的「全」是丘、墓、棺、椁几样都齐了。 卜筮大全的这一章后面还有「虎易评注」（今人加的），本库不引。
note.en: The 'two killings' are the Three Mounds and the Five Tombs, of which the book says 'all given later' — in the later chapter on malign killings. How the Three Mounds and Five Tombs are set (Chou in spring, Chen in summer, Wei in autumn and Xu in winter for the Three Mounds, the Five Tombs taken from the opposite palace) is in the Yilin Buyi's 'general discourse on ghosts by the stars and killings' (LY.ILL.EL.51), and 'even if the sick person performs blessing rites he can hardly be kept' is the very line of that verse. 'Thunder and Wind' are the Zhen (thunder) and Xun (wind) trigrams: Zhen is the coffin and Xun the outer coffin, the same saying as 'thunder and wind combining, coffin and outer coffin complete' in the Zengshan Buyi (LY.ILL.ZS.15). The 'all' of 'if in divining illness all are present' is that the mound, the tomb, the coffin and the outer coffin are all there. After this chapter the Buyi Daquan also has 'Huyi's commentary' (added by a modern hand), which this library does not quote.

units.title: 既论染灾之表里须言得病之因由：先断症候然后议病因；六兽临官分内外、八宫值鬼别阴阳；鬼临六神看在何爻——在内在家得病、在外他处招殃；青龙鬼酒色过度或因财有伤、妇人因喜有疾、鬼空堕胎；朱雀口舌咒咀（二爻灶下三爻当门或家堂神前、金鬼动敲锅铛）；勾陈饮食不节脾胃不调、临木鬼因修造动土；螣蛇事务萦心忧愁思虑虚惊怪异；白虎斗殴跌扑伤筋损骨或寒酸冲肺；玄武色欲过度伤饥冒雨

rule.yi: 已经讲了染灾的表里，还要说得病的因由。注说：占病，先断定症候，然后议论病因；能把这一章弄明白，才称得上通神的占卜。六兽临在官鬼上，要分内外；八宫值鬼，要分阴阳。注说：但凡鬼临着六神，就看它在哪一爻：在内，是在家里得病；在外，是在别处招来的灾殃。青龙鬼：酒色过度，或者因为财而有伤，妇人是因喜事有病；青龙鬼落空，有堕胎的忧患。朱雀鬼：口舌和咒骂，在二爻是在灶下咒骂，在三爻是当门咒骂，或者是家堂神前咒骂；如果朱雀临着金鬼发动，是敲着锅铛咒骂。勾陈鬼：饮食不节制，饥饱失常，脾胃不调；临着木鬼，是在修造动土的地方得的病。螣蛇鬼：事务缠心，忧愁思虑，或者虚惊怪异，因而得病，这一爻大多是心家受病。白虎鬼：斗殴、跌扑，伤筋损骨，或者是寒酸冲肺。玄武鬼：色欲过度，饥饱失常、冒雨。
rule.en: Having discussed the outside and inside of the infection, one must now speak of the cause of the illness. The commentary says: in divining illness, first settle the symptoms, and then discuss the cause; if one can understand this chapter, one may truly be called one whose divination reaches the gods. When the six beasts sit on the Pressure line one must distinguish inside and outside; when the ghost falls in the eight palaces one should tell yin from yang. The commentary says: whenever a ghost sits on one of the six spirits, look at which line it is on: inside, the illness was got at home; outside, calamity was brought on elsewhere. The Azure Dragon ghost: excess in wine and lust, or injury through wealth, and in a woman illness from a joyful event; the Azure Dragon ghost Void: the danger of miscarriage. The Vermilion Bird ghost: quarrels and cursing; on the second line, cursing beside the stove; on the third line, cursing at the door, or cursing before the household gods; if the Vermilion Bird sits on a Metal ghost that moves, cursing while banging pots and pans. The Hook Earth ghost: irregular eating, hunger and overeating, the spleen and stomach out of order; if it sits on a Wood ghost, the illness was got at a place of building and digging. The Coiling Snake ghost: affairs entangling the heart, worry and brooding, or a false fright and strangeness, and so the illness is contracted; this line is mostly an illness of the heart. The White Tiger ghost: brawls and falls, injury to sinews and bones, or cold and sourness striking the lungs. The Dark Tortoise ghost: excess of lust, hunger and overeating, and exposure to rain.

yi: 已经论过染灾的表里，
还须说到得病的因由。
en: Having discussed the outside and inside of the infection,
one must now speak of the cause of the illness.

yi: 凡是占病，
先断定症候的确切，
然后议论病因。
更能弄明白这一章，
确实可以称为通神的占卜了。
en: In divining illness,
first settle the symptoms precisely,
and then discuss the cause.
If one can further understand this chapter,
one may truly be called one whose divination reaches the gods.

yi: 六兽临在官上，
应当分内外；
八宫值鬼，
应当分阴阳。
en: When the six beasts sit on the Pressure line,
one must distinguish inside and outside;
when the ghost falls in the eight palaces,
one should tell yin from yang.

zh: 但逢鬼临六神，看在何爻。在内则在家得病，在外则他处招殃。
青龙鬼：是酒色过度，或因财有伤，妇人因喜有疾；
朱雀鬼：口舌及咒咀。在二爻，灶下咒咀；在三爻，当门咒咀；或家堂神前咒咀。
如朱雀临金鬼动，敲锅铛咒咀。
勾陈鬼：饮食不节，伤饥失饱，脾胃不调。临木鬼：因修造动土处得病。
螣蛇鬼：事务萦心，忧愁思虑，或虚惊怪异，因而染病。此爻多是心家受病。
白虎鬼：斗殴跌扑，伤筋损骨，或寒酸冲肺。
玄武鬼：色欲过度，伤饥冒雨。
yi: 但凡鬼临着六神，就看它在哪一爻。在内，是在家里得病；在外，是在别处招来的灾殃。
青龙鬼：是酒色过度，或者因为财有伤，妇人是因喜事有病；
青龙鬼落空，有堕胎的忧患。
朱雀鬼：口舌和咒骂；在二爻，是在灶下咒骂；在三爻，是当门咒骂；或者是家堂神前咒骂。
如果朱雀临着金鬼发动，是敲着锅铛咒骂。
勾陈鬼：饮食不节制，饥饱失常，脾胃不调；临着木鬼，是在修造动土的地方得的病。
螣蛇鬼：事务缠心，忧愁思虑，或者虚惊怪异，因而得病；这一爻大多是心家受病。
白虎鬼：斗殴、跌扑，伤筋损骨，或者是寒酸冲肺。
玄武鬼：色欲过度，饥饱失常、冒雨。
en: Whenever a ghost sits on one of the six spirits, look at which line it is on: inside, the illness was got at home; outside, calamity was brought on elsewhere.
The Azure Dragon ghost: excess in wine and lust, or injury through wealth, and in a woman illness from a joyful event;
the Azure Dragon ghost Void: the danger of miscarriage.
The Vermilion Bird ghost: quarrels and cursing; on the second line, cursing beside the stove; on the third line, cursing at the door; or cursing before the household gods.
If the Vermilion Bird sits on a Metal ghost that moves, cursing while banging pots and pans.
The Hook Earth ghost: irregular eating, hunger and overeating, the spleen and stomach out of order; if it sits on a Wood ghost, the illness was got at a place of building and digging.
The Coiling Snake ghost: affairs entangling the heart, worry and brooding, or a false fright and strangeness, and so the illness is contracted; this line is mostly an illness of the heart.
The White Tiger ghost: brawls and falls, injury to sinews and bones, or cold and sourness striking the lungs.
The Dark Tortoise ghost: excess of lust, hunger and overeating, and exposure to rain.

note.yi: 这一节接上一条（TXF.08）之后，是「先断症候、再议病因」的分界：赋文「既论染灾之表里，须言得病之因由」是上半章（症候、轻重、生死）到下半章（病因、医药）的转折句。「六兽临官」是官鬼临着哪一神，「八宫值鬼宜别阴阳」是鬼在哪一宫、阴爻还是阳爻，注文只详细写了六兽，没有展开八宫。六神鬼的病因和易隐「病因·六神」（LY.ILL.YY.17）、易林补遗「按六神论病由何得」（LY.ILL.EL.05）、黄金策六神病因是同一类办法，天玄赋这里还多了一层：朱雀鬼在二爻是灶下咒咀、三爻是当门咒咀，金鬼动是「敲锅铛咒咀」，这和易隐同条几乎一字不差（LY.ILL.YY.17「朱雀……二爻灶下、三爻当门、五爻香火道路、金鬼敲锅」），易隐还多了五爻。「寒酸冲肺」按字面译作「cold and sourness striking the lungs」。「妇人因喜有疾」是女人因喜事（生子、宴会）得病。 卜筮大全的这一章后面还有「虎易评注」（今人加的），本库不引。
note.en: This section follows the previous entry (TXF.08) and is the dividing line between 'first settle the symptoms, then discuss the cause': the verse 'having discussed the outside and inside of the infection, one must speak of the cause of the illness' is the turn from the first half of the chapter (symptoms, light and heavy, life and death) to the second (cause, medicine). 'The six beasts sit on the Pressure line' is which spirit the Pressure line sits on, and 'the ghost falls in the eight palaces, tell yin from yang' is which palace the ghost is in and whether the line is yin or yang, but the commentary sets out only the six beasts in detail and does not expand the eight palaces. The causes of illness by the six spirits are the same kind of method as the Yi Yin's 'cause of illness by the six spirits' (LY.ILL.YY.17), the Yilin Buyi's 'how the illness was contracted by the six spirits' (LY.ILL.EL.05) and the Huangjin Ce's causes by the six spirits, and here the Tianxuan Fu adds a further layer: the Vermilion Bird ghost on the second line is cursing beside the stove and on the third line cursing at the door, and a Metal ghost moving is 'cursing while banging pots and pans', which is almost word for word the same as the Yi Yin's same entry (LY.ILL.YY.17, 'the Vermilion Bird ... second line beside the stove, third line at the door, fifth line incense fire and roads, a Metal ghost banging pots'), the Yi Yin adding the fifth line. 'Cold and sourness striking the lungs' is rendered literally. 'In a woman illness from a joyful event' is a woman falling ill from a joyful event (a birth, a feast). After this chapter the Buyi Daquan also has 'Huyi's commentary' (added by a modern hand), which this library does not quote.

units.title: 卦若无鬼病难医症候难决：以克杀动者断、不动以克用爻者断、又以伏鬼断；鬼伏父母下忧心得病或穿衣过与不及（冬言衣单夏言衣重）、伏兄弟下赌博争财、伏子孙下外情牵惹、伏财下饮食太过、伏杀下旧病再发难除根；老人卦忌生旺、小儿卦忌休囚；最宜病人本命上卦；阴鬼夜重日轻、阳鬼夜轻日重

rule.yi: 卦里如果没有鬼，病就难医，症候也难决断。只能用克的杀发动的来断；不动的，就用克用爻的来断，再用伏着的鬼来断。如果鬼伏在父母爻下：忧心得的病，或者穿衣服得的病，穿得过多或不足，冬天就说衣服单薄，夏天就说衣服厚重。鬼伏在兄弟下：赌博争财；伏在子孙下：被外面的情事牵惹；伏在财下：饮食太过；伏在杀下：旧病再发，也难除根。老人的卦忌旺相，小孩的卦忌休囚。最好是病人的本命上卦，大吉。遇到阴鬼，夜里重白天轻；阳鬼，夜里轻白天重；阴阳各自依爻上来看。
rule.en: If there is no ghost in the hexagram, the illness is hard to treat and the symptoms hard to decide. One can only judge by the killing that controls and moves; if it does not move, judge by what controls the Subject line, and also judge by the hidden ghost. If the ghost is hidden under Resource: illness got from a worried heart, or from clothing, too much or too little: in winter say the clothes were thin, in summer say the clothes were heavy. The ghost hidden under Peer: gambling and quarrels over money; hidden under Output: entangled by an affair outside; hidden under Wealth: excess in food and drink; hidden under a killing: an old illness flares again, and it is also hard to root out. An old person's hexagram fears being strong, a child's hexagram fears being resting or trapped. Best is for the sick person's natal line to be in the hexagram, which is greatly auspicious. A yin ghost is heavy at night and light by day; a yang ghost is light at night and heavy by day; yin and yang are each read from the line.

zh: 卦若无鬼，其病难医，症候难决。
但以克杀动者断之；不动，以克用爻者断，又以伏鬼断。
若鬼伏父母下：忧心得病，
过与不及，冬言衣单，夏言衣重。
鬼伏杀下：旧病再发，亦难除根。
老人卦忌生旺，小儿卦忌休囚。
最宜病人本命上卦，大吉也。
值阴鬼，夜重日轻；阳鬼，夜轻日重。
yi: 卦里如果没有鬼，病就难医，症候也难决断。
只能用克的杀发动的来断；不动的，就用克用爻的来断，再用伏着的鬼来断。
如果鬼伏在父母爻下：忧心得的病，
或者穿衣服得的病；
穿得过多或不足，冬天就说衣服单薄，夏天就说衣服厚重。
鬼伏在兄弟下：赌博争财；
鬼伏在子孙下：被外面的情事牵惹；
鬼伏在财下：饮食太过；
鬼伏在杀下：旧病再发，也难除根。
老人的卦忌旺相，小孩的卦忌休囚。
最好是病人的本命上卦，大吉。
遇到阴鬼，夜里重白天轻；阳鬼，夜里轻白天重。
阴阳各自依爻上来看。
en: If there is no ghost in the hexagram, the illness is hard to treat and the symptoms hard to decide.
One can only judge by the killing that controls and moves; if it does not move, judge by what controls the Subject line, and also judge by the hidden ghost.
If the ghost is hidden under Resource: illness got from a worried heart,
or from clothing;
too much or too little: in winter say the clothes were thin, in summer say the clothes were heavy.
The ghost hidden under Peer: gambling and quarrels over money;
hidden under Output: entangled by an affair outside;
hidden under Wealth: excess in food and drink;
hidden under a killing: an old illness flares again, and it is also hard to root out.
An old person's hexagram fears being strong, a child's hexagram fears being resting or trapped.
Best is for the sick person's natal line to be in the hexagram, which is greatly auspicious.
A yin ghost is heavy at night and light by day; a yang ghost is light at night and heavy by day.
Yin and yang are each read from the line.

dispute.yi: 病在昼夜哪一头重，几家的依据不同。天玄赋注（LY.ILL.TXF.10）是「阴鬼夜重日轻、阳鬼夜轻日重」，和易隐（LY.ILL.YY.15）一致，都按官鬼的阴阳分；海底眼（LY.ILL.HDY.02）、黄金策的旧注和王洪绪（LY.ILL.HJC.12）则按官鬼在内卦还是外卦分（内卦夜重、外卦白天重）。两个标准可以给出相反的结论，书里没有裁决。
dispute.en: Whether an illness is heavier by day or by night: the books use different criteria. The commentary on the Tianxuan Fu (LY.ILL.TXF.10) has 'a yin ghost is heavy at night and light by day, a yang ghost light at night and heavy by day', which agrees with the Yi Yin (LY.ILL.YY.15) in dividing by the yin or yang of the Pressure line; the Haidi Yan (LY.ILL.HDY.02), the old commentary of the Huangjin Ce and Wang Hongxu (LY.ILL.HJC.12) divide instead by whether the Pressure line is in the inner or outer trigram (inner trigram heavy at night, outer trigram heavy by day). The two criteria can give opposite conclusions, and the books do not settle it.

note.yi: 这一节是「卦无鬼」时怎么办：没有官鬼，病难医、症候难决，就退而求其次——用「克杀动者」（克用爻的煞在动）断；它不动，用「克用爻者」断；再用「伏鬼」断，也就是官鬼伏在哪一爻下。伏鬼的六亲断法和海底眼（LY.ILL.HDY.04）、易冒的六亲（LY.ILL.YM.60 一带）是同一个路子：父母下是忧虑或穿衣、兄弟下是赌博争财、子孙下是外情牵惹、财下是饮食太过、杀下是旧病再发。「穿衣服得病，过与不及，冬言衣单，夏言衣重」是说冬天穿得少，夏天穿得多——按季节说得病是穿衣不当。「老人卦忌生旺，小儿卦忌休囚」和易隐（LY.ILL.YY.10）「少年卦忌死囚休废、老人卦忌旺相」同一句。「最宜病人本命上卦」的「本命」是病人的生年属相所在的爻（本命爻）。 卜筮大全的这一章后面还有「虎易评注」（今人加的），本库不引。
note.en: This section is about what to do when the hexagram has no ghost: with no Pressure line the illness is hard to treat and the symptoms hard to decide, and one falls back on the next best — judging by 'the killing that controls and moves' (the killing that controls the Subject line moving); if it does not move, judging by 'what controls the Subject line'; and further judging by the hidden ghost, that is, under which line the Pressure line hides. The six-relation reading of a hidden ghost is on the same road as the Haidi Yan (LY.ILL.HDY.04) and the Yi Mao's six relations (LY.ILL.YM.60 and around): under Resource, worry or clothing; under Peer, gambling and quarrels over money; under Output, entangled by an affair outside; under Wealth, excess in food and drink; under a killing, an old illness flares again. 'Illness from clothing, too much or too little; in winter say the clothes were thin, in summer say the clothes were heavy' says that a person who wore too little in winter or too much in summer fell ill from wearing the wrong clothing for the season. 'An old person's hexagram fears being strong, a child's hexagram fears being resting or trapped' is the same sentence as the Yi Yin's (LY.ILL.YY.10, 'a young person's hexagram fears Death, trapped, resting and abandoned, an old person's hexagram fears being strong'). The 'natal' of 'best is for the sick person's natal line to be in the hexagram' is the line where the sick person's birth animal falls (the natal line). After this chapter the Buyi Daquan also has 'Huyi's commentary' (added by a modern hand), which this library does not quote.

units.title: 世人有疾病者亦有贤愚之分：贤者以医药为重、愚者以祷告为先，占者要察其情状；鬼神儒家本不言、为患者之占不得不据理推详以为阴功默佑；木主东岳天齐圣帝等、水是河泊水府等、土是瘟蝗疫疠中央土府之神、金是衔刀五道飞廉白虎金神七杀等、火是南方火部赤睛朱发鹤神等，各连着相应的伤亡之鬼；二爻鬼为灶神、三爻鬼为香火神、子孙动为福神

rule.yi: 世上的人有了病，也有贤愚的分别：贤的把医药放在首位，愚的把祷告放在前头；占卜的人不能不察看他的情状，一眼看去就能知道高下，这样贤的愚的都可以和他说得上话，这门学问才能流传。至于鬼神，儒家本来不说这些，现在为病人占卜，不得不按道理推详，当作暗中的阴功和默佑。木鬼：是东岳天齐圣帝、七十二司、三十六案的神，还有自吊而亡的；水鬼：是河泊水府、沿江七十二庙的神，还有溺水而亡的；土鬼：是瘟蝗疫疠、中央土府的神，还有饥饿绝食而亡的；金鬼：是衔刀、五道、飞廉、白虎、金神、七杀、吟呻、三杀、九良星杀、丧殃、丧杀之神，还有自刎、被刑、阵亡，一切伤亡；火鬼：是南方火部、赤睛朱发的鹤神、毛头毒火之神，还有赴汤蹈火而亡的。如果二爻是鬼，就是灶神；三爻是鬼，是香火神；子孙动是福神。照这样推，万无一失。
rule.en: People with illness are also divided into the worthy and the foolish: the worthy put medicine first, the foolish put prayer first; the one who divines must not fail to observe his circumstances, and one look at the person shows high or low, so that worthy and foolish can both be spoken to and this way can circulate. As for ghosts and spirits, the Confucians did not speak of them originally; now, for divining for the sick, one cannot but reason it out from principle, taking it as hidden merit and silent protection. A Wood ghost: Tianqi, the Holy Emperor of the Eastern Peak, the seventy-two departments and the spirits of the thirty-six cases, and also those who hanged themselves; a Water ghost: the River Count and the Water Mansion, the spirits of the seventy-two temples along the river, and also the drowned; an Earth ghost: epidemic, locusts and plague, the spirits of the central Earth Mansion, and also those who died of hunger and starvation; a Metal ghost: the knife-bearing, the Five Roads, Feilian and the White Tiger, the Golden Spirit, the Seven Killings, Yinshen, the Three Killings, the Nine Good Star killings, the spirits of Mourning Calamity and the Mourning Killing, and also every wounding and death by cutting the throat, by execution or in battle; a Fire ghost: the southern Fire Department, the crane spirit with red eyes and vermilion hair, the shaggy-headed poison-fire spirit, and also those who died going into boiling water and fire. If the ghost is on the second line it is the Kitchen God; if on the third line it is the incense-fire spirit; Output moving is the fortune god. Reasoning from this, not one error in ten thousand.

zh: 世人有疾病者，亦有贤愚之分。
贤者以医药为重，愚者以祷告为先。
一览其人，可知高下，庶几贤愚，皆可共语，其道方能流行。
yi: 世上的人有了疾病，也有贤愚的分别。
贤的把医药放在重要的位置，愚的把祷告放在前头。
占卜的人不可以不察看他的情状。
一眼看去这个人，就能知道高下，这样贤愚都可以和他说得上话，这门学问才能流传。
en: Among people with illness there are also the worthy and the foolish.
The worthy put medicine first, the foolish put prayer first.
The one who divines must not fail to observe his circumstances.
One look at the person shows high or low, so that worthy and foolish can both be spoken to, and only then can this way circulate.

yi: 说到鬼神：
儒家本来不说这些，
现在为患病的人占卜，
不得不按道理推详，
当作暗中的阴功和默佑。
en: As for ghosts and spirits:
the Confucians did not speak of them originally;
now, for divining for the sick,
one cannot but reason it out from principle,
taking it as hidden merit and silent protection.

zh: 木主东岳天齐圣帝，七十二司，三十六案之神，并自吊伤亡。
水是河泊水府，沿江七十二庙之神，并溺水伤亡。
土是瘟蝗疫疠，中央土府之神，并饥饿绝食伤亡。
金是衔刀、五道，飞廉、白虎，金神、七杀，吟呻、三杀，九良星杀，丧殃、丧杀之神，并自刎、被刑、阵亡，一应伤亡。
火是南方火部，赤睛朱发鹤神、毛头毒火之神，并赴汤蹈火伤亡。
若二爻鬼为灶神，三爻鬼为香火神，子孙动为福神。
yi: 木鬼：是东岳天齐圣帝、七十二司、三十六案的神，还有自吊而亡的。
水鬼：是河泊水府、沿江七十二庙的神，还有溺水而亡的。
土鬼：是瘟蝗疫疠、中央土府的神，还有饥饿绝食而亡的。
金鬼：是衔刀、五道、飞廉、白虎、金神、七杀、吟呻、三杀、九良星杀、丧殃、丧杀之神，还有自刎、被刑、阵亡，一切伤亡。
火鬼：是南方火部、赤睛朱发的鹤神、毛头毒火之神，还有赴汤蹈火而亡的。
如果二爻的鬼是灶神，三爻的鬼是香火神，子孙动是福神。
照这样推，万无一失。
en: A Wood ghost: Tianqi, the Holy Emperor of the Eastern Peak, the seventy-two departments and the spirits of the thirty-six cases, and also those who hanged themselves.
A Water ghost: the River Count and the Water Mansion, the spirits of the seventy-two temples along the river, and also the drowned.
An Earth ghost: epidemic, locusts and plague, the spirits of the central Earth Mansion, and also those who died of hunger and starvation.

A Metal ghost: the knife-bearing, the Five Roads, Feilian and the White Tiger, the Golden Spirit, the Seven Killings, Yinshen, the Three Killings, the Nine Good Star killings, the spirits of Mourning Calamity and the Mourning Killing, and also every wounding and death by cutting the throat, by execution or in battle.
A Fire ghost: the southern Fire Department, the crane spirit with red eyes and vermilion hair, the shaggy-headed poison-fire spirit, and also those who died going into boiling water and fire.
If the ghost on the second line is the Kitchen God, the ghost on the third line the incense-fire spirit, and Output moving the fortune god,
reasoning from this, not one error in ten thousand.

note.yi: 这一节是天玄赋对「鬼神」的态度和名单。态度：「鬼神者，儒家本不言此」——本来不说，但因为病人占卜，不得不据理推详，当作「阴功默佑」；这和黄金策、易冒把神鬼只当大类看的态度接近，和易林补遗把神名逐个点出的做法不同。名单按五行给：木（东岳天齐圣帝等）、水（河泊水府）、土（瘟蝗疫疠、中央土府）、金（衔刀五道飞廉白虎金神七杀等）、火（南方火部、鹤神、毒火之神），每类还带着相应的死法。这一套和黄金策「五行推鬼神」（LY.ILL.HJC.97）、易隐「鬼崇·神与鬼的名目」（LY.ILL.YY.28）、易林补遗的五行诀（LY.ILL.EL.46）是同一类名单，野鹤则批评把金官指为关公岳公等具体神（LY.ILL.ZS.24）。「二爻鬼为灶神、三爻鬼为香火神、子孙动为福神」和易林补遗「按爻位断神鬼」（LY.ILL.EL.37）、黄金策「六爻推鬼神」（LY.ILL.HJC.101）一致。「吟呻」「三杀」「九良星杀」「丧殃」照字面译；「赤睛朱发鹤神」「毛头毒火之神」是形容火部神的样子，按字面译。「自吊」是上吊自尽。 卜筮大全的这一章后面还有「虎易评注」（今人加的），本库不引。 这一段里神、鬼、星煞的名字，书里没有解释，这里按字面译或音译，不作认定。
note.en: This section is the Tianxuan Fu's attitude to and list of 'ghosts and spirits'. The attitude: 'as for ghosts and spirits, the Confucians did not speak of them' — they did not originally, but for the divining of the sick one cannot but reason it out from principle, taking it as 'hidden merit and silent protection'; this is close to the Huangjin Ce and the Yi Mao, which treat gods and ghosts only as broad kinds, and unlike the Yilin Buyi, which names the gods one by one. The list is given by the five phases: Wood (Tianqi, the Holy Emperor of the Eastern Peak and so on), Water (the River Count and the Water Mansion), Earth (epidemic, locusts and plague, the central Earth Mansion), Metal (the knife-bearing, the Five Roads, Feilian, the White Tiger, the Golden Spirit, the Seven Killings and so on) and Fire (the southern Fire Department, the crane spirit, the poison-fire spirit), each with its matching kind of death. This is the same kind of list as the Huangjin Ce's 'the five phases and the gods and ghosts' (LY.ILL.HJC.97), the Yi Yin's 'the names of gods and ghosts' (LY.ILL.YY.28) and the Yilin Buyi's verse on the five phases (LY.ILL.EL.46), while the Old Man of Yehe criticises pointing a Metal Pressure line at particular gods such as Guan Gong and Yue Gong (LY.ILL.ZS.24). 'A ghost on the second line is the Kitchen God, a ghost on the third line the incense-fire spirit, Output moving the fortune god' agrees with the Yilin Buyi's 'ghosts and spirits by line position' (LY.ILL.EL.37) and the Huangjin Ce's 'the six lines and gods and ghosts' (LY.ILL.HJC.101). 'Yinshen', 'the Three Killings', 'the Nine Good Star killings' and 'Mourning Calamity' are rendered literally; 'the crane spirit with red eyes and vermilion hair' and 'the shaggy-headed poison-fire spirit' describe how the gods of the Fire Department look, and are rendered literally. 'Zi diao' is hanging oneself. After this chapter the Buyi Daquan also has 'Huyi's commentary' (added by a modern hand), which this library does not quote. Names of gods, spirits and stars in this passage are given by transliteration or plain rendering; the book does not explain them, and none is identified here beyond what the book says.

units.title: 医药：伏克飞爻药奏通神之效、子临应位医逢济世之才；世为病人、应及外卦为医药，药克病则愈、病克药则药无灵，外卦及应生世药虽对症作效迟；世动克药按五行（水鬼服药不纳、金鬼久病无效、木鬼犯条贯亦无益、火鬼不能止热、土鬼不对症），应加鬼克世误药损人；子孙为医药临应动克世必遇良医、卦无子孙服药无效、世应比和无子宜换医、子孙临应被世克虽遇良医病未疗、外卦及应克世无福德难安、虎杀临子孙动防医不精

rule.yi: 伏爻克飞爻，药奏神效；子孙临在应位，医生遇上济世之才。注说：世是病人，应和外卦是医药；药如果克病，病就好；病人克药，药就没有灵验；外卦和应生世，药虽然对症，见效迟。世动克药：如果是水鬼，服药不纳；金鬼无气、久病犯真（此处含混），服药无效；木鬼，病一定犯了条贯，即使有药也没有益处；火鬼旺相，症一定刚烈，药也止不住它的热；土鬼，病沉重，药不对症，不能治病；应爻加鬼克世，那就是误了药、损了人。占病以子孙为医药：临应发动克世，必遇良医，病马上痊愈；卦里没有子孙，服药无效；世应比和、卦里又没有子孙，宜换医生；子孙临应爻被世克，虽遇良医病也没有治；外卦和应虽克世，卦里没有福德也难安，可以说有药应当治，只恐怕良医没有缘；子孙虽克世，外爻和应却不克，虽有良医，药饵不中，终究没有大害；虎杀如果临着子孙发动，要防医生不精细。
rule.en: The hidden line controlling the flying line: the medicine works with wondrous effect; Output sitting on the Other's place: the doctor meets one of world-saving talent. The commentary says: the Self is the sick person, the Other line and the outer trigram are the doctor and the medicine; if the medicine controls the illness, the illness is cured at once; if the sick person controls the medicine, the medicine has no effect; if the outer trigram and the Other generate the Self, though the medicine suits the symptoms it takes effect slowly. The Self moving and controlling the medicine: if it is a Water ghost, the medicine taken is not kept down; a Metal ghost without qi, in a long illness that has offended 'the true' (the words are unclear), taking medicine is ineffective; a Wood ghost: the illness surely offends the regulations, and even medicine is of no benefit; a strong Fire ghost: the symptoms are surely fierce and even medicine cannot stop the heat; an Earth ghost: the illness is heavy, the medicine does not suit the symptoms and cannot treat the illness; the Other line with a ghost added controlling the Self is the wrong medicine harming the person. In divining illness Output is the medicine and doctor: sitting on the Other and moving to control the Self, one meets a good doctor and the illness is cured at once; with no Output in the hexagram, taking medicine is ineffective; with the Self and Other harmonious and no Output in the hexagram, one should change the doctor; Output on the Other line controlled by the Self, though one meets a good doctor the illness is not treated; the outer trigram and the Other though controlling the Self, if the hexagram has no Output (the fortune spirit) it is still hard to be at peace, and one may say there is medicine that should treat it but fear the good doctor has no affinity; Output though controlling the Self, if the outer line and the Other do not control it, though there is a good doctor and the medicine does not hit, in the end there is no great harm; if a Tiger killing sits on Output and moves, beware the doctor not being careful.

yi: 伏爻克了飞爻，
药起到通神的效果；
子孙临在应的位置上，
医生遇上济世的人才。
en: The hidden line controlling the flying line,
the medicine works with wondrous effect;
Output sitting on the Other's place,
the doctor meets one of world-saving talent.

zh: 世为病人，应及外卦为医药。
外卦及应生世，药虽对症，作效迟。
世动克药，若是水鬼，服药不纳；
金鬼无气，久病犯真，服药无效；
木鬼，其病必犯条贯，虽药亦无益；
火鬼旺相，其症必刚，虽药不能止其热；
土鬼，其病沉重，药不对症，不能疗病。
应爻加鬼克世，则误药损人矣。
yi: 世是病人，应和外卦是医药。
药如果克了病，病就好；
病人克了药，药没有灵验。
外卦和应生世，药虽然对症，见效迟。
世动克药：如果是水鬼，服药不纳；
金鬼无气，久病犯真（此处含混），服药无效；
木鬼，病一定犯了条贯，虽然有药也没有益处；
火鬼旺相，症一定刚烈，药也止不住它的热；
土鬼，病沉重，药不对症，不能治病。
应爻加鬼克世，那就是误了药、损了人。
en: The Self is the sick person; the Other line and the outer trigram are the doctor and the medicine.
If the medicine controls the illness, the illness is cured at once;
if the sick person controls the medicine, the medicine has no effect.
If the outer trigram and the Other generate the Self, though the medicine suits the symptoms it takes effect slowly.
The Self moving and controlling the medicine: if it is a Water ghost, the medicine taken is not kept down;
a Metal ghost without qi, in a long illness that has offended 'the true' (the words are unclear), taking medicine is ineffective;
a Wood ghost: the illness surely offends the regulations, and even medicine is of no benefit;
a strong Fire ghost: the symptoms are surely fierce and even medicine cannot stop the heat;
an Earth ghost: the illness is heavy, the medicine does not suit the symptoms and cannot treat the illness.
the Other line with a ghost added controlling the Self is the wrong medicine harming the person.

zh: 占病以子孙为医药，临应动克世，必遇良医，其病即痊。
世应比和，卦无子孙，宜换医人。
子孙临应被世克，虽遇良医病未疗。
外卦及应虽克世，卦无福德亦难安；可言有药须当疗，但恐良医未有缘。
子孙虽克世，外爻及应却不克，虽有良医，药饵不中，终无大害。
虎杀若临子孙动，须防医者不精详。
yi: 占病以子孙为医药：临应发动克世，必遇良医，病马上痊愈；
卦里没有子孙，服药无效；
世应比和、卦里又没有子孙，宜换医生；
子孙临应爻被世克，虽遇良医病也没有治；
外卦和应虽然克世，卦里没有福德也难安，可以说有药应当治，只恐怕良医没有缘；
子孙虽克世，外爻和应却不克，虽有良医，药饵不中，终究没有大害；
虎杀如果临着子孙发动，要防医生不精细。
en: In divining illness Output is the medicine and doctor: sitting on the Other and moving to control the Self, one meets a good doctor and the illness is cured at once;
with no Output in the hexagram, taking medicine is ineffective;
with the Self and Other harmonious and no Output in the hexagram, one should change the doctor;
Output on the Other line controlled by the Self, though one meets a good doctor the illness is not treated;

the outer trigram and the Other though controlling the Self, if the hexagram has no Output (the fortune spirit) it is still hard to be at peace, and one may say there is medicine that should treat it but fear the good doctor has no affinity;
Output though controlling the Self, if the outer line and the Other do not control it, though there is a good doctor and the medicine does not hit, in the end there is no great harm;
if a Tiger killing sits on Output and moves, beware the doctor not being careful.

note.yi: 这一节是医药：「世为病人，应及外卦为医药」——世是病人、应和外卦（应爻和外卦）是医和药；药克病则愈、病克药则无灵、外卦及应生世则药对症但效迟。这个「应为医、世为病人、子孙为药」的三角和易隐「医药·药效」（LY.ILL.YY.21）、易林补遗「求医疗病」（LY.ILL.EL.26）、增删卜易（LY.ILL.ZS.29）一致；「子孙为医药」和易冒「占医药以子孙为用」（LY.ILL.YM.34）相同。五行鬼的一段（水鬼服药不纳、金鬼无效、木鬼犯条贯、火鬼刚症、土鬼沉重）和黄金策的医药（LY.ILL.HJC.7x 一带）对得上。「久病犯真」文字含混，按字面译并标出；「条贯」是条规，「病必犯条贯」按字面译作「the illness surely offends the regulations」（可能指病是犯了什么规矩得的，书里没有解释）；「虎杀」是白虎之类的凶煞，这里写「虎杀」而不写「白虎」，译作 Tiger killing。「误药损人」是药用错了，伤了人。 卜筮大全的这一章后面还有「虎易评注」（今人加的），本库不引。
note.en: This section is about medicine: 'the Self is the sick person, the Other and the outer trigram are the doctor and the medicine'; the medicine controlling the illness cures, the sick person controlling the medicine leaves it without effect, and the outer trigram and the Other generating the Self make the medicine suit the symptoms but act slowly. This triangle 'the Other is the doctor, the Self the sick person, Output the medicine' agrees with the Yi Yin's 'medicine: the effect of the medicine' (LY.ILL.YY.21), the Yilin Buyi's 'seeking a doctor to treat illness' (LY.ILL.EL.26) and the Zengshan Buyi (LY.ILL.ZS.29); and 'Output is the medicine and doctor' is the same as the Yi Mao's 'divining medicine takes Output as the Subject' (LY.ILL.YM.34). The passage on the ghosts of the five phases (Water ghost the medicine not kept down, Metal ghost without effect, Wood ghost offending the regulations, Fire ghost a fierce condition, Earth ghost heavy) matches the Huangjin Ce's medicine passages (LY.ILL.HJC.7x and around). 'A long illness that has offended the true' is unclear, and is translated literally and marked; 'tiao guan' is regulation, and 'the illness surely offends the regulations' is rendered literally (it may mean that the illness was got by breaking some rule, which the book does not explain); 'Tiger killing' is a malign killing such as the White Tiger, and the text writes 'Tiger killing' and not 'White Tiger', so it is translated as Tiger killing. 'The wrong medicine harming the person' is medicine wrongly used and injuring the person. After this chapter the Buyi Daquan also has 'Huyi's commentary' (added by a modern hand), which this library does not quote.

units.title: 必须参究五行方可攻医万病：火鬼宜凉剂、水鬼宜温剂或丸药、木鬼宜针、金鬼宜灸、土鬼宜剉散（火鬼月建旺宜大寒之剂、无气不过清凉）；金鬼利南方医人、木鬼利西方、水鬼利四散、火鬼利北方、土鬼利东方；前卦水鬼后卦火鬼先须四散医治、终于北方医人收功

rule.yi: 必须钻研五行，才可以攻医各种病。注说：火鬼宜凉剂；水鬼宜温剂，或者丸药；木鬼宜针；金鬼宜灸；土鬼宜剉散。火鬼在月建旺的时候，宜大寒之剂；无气，不过用清凉的药。其余照这样推。金鬼利于请南方的医生，木鬼利西方的医生，水鬼利四散的医生，火鬼利北方的医生，土鬼利东方的医生。如果前一卦是水鬼、后一卦是火鬼，先要四散地医治，最后由北方的医生收功。
rule.en: One must study the five phases before one can attack and treat the myriad illnesses. The commentary says: a Fire ghost suits cooling remedies; a Water ghost suits warming remedies, or pills; a Wood ghost suits the needle; a Metal ghost suits moxa; an Earth ghost suits cut-and-ground powders. When a Fire ghost is strong on the Month, it suits very cold remedies; without qi, only cooling and clearing medicines; the rest follow this. A Metal ghost favours a doctor from the south, a Wood ghost a doctor from the west, a Water ghost doctors from all quarters, a Fire ghost a doctor from the north, an Earth ghost a doctor from the east. If the earlier hexagram is a Water ghost and the later a Fire ghost, one must first treat with doctors from all quarters, and the work is completed at the end by a doctor from the north.

yi: 必须参究五行，
才可以攻医各种病。
en: One must study the five phases,
and only then can one attack and treat the myriad illnesses.

zh: 火鬼月建旺，宜大寒之剂；
yi: 火鬼宜用凉剂；
水鬼宜用温剂，或者丸药；
木鬼宜用针；
金鬼宜用灸；
土鬼宜用剉散。
火鬼在月建旺的时候，宜用大寒的药剂；
无气的，不过用清凉的药。
其余照这样推。
en: A Fire ghost suits cooling remedies;
a Water ghost suits warming remedies, or pills;
a Wood ghost suits the needle;
a Metal ghost suits moxa;
an Earth ghost suits cut-and-ground powders.
When a Fire ghost is strong on the Month, it suits very cold remedies;
without qi, only cooling and clearing medicines.
The rest follow this.

yi: 金鬼利于请南方的医生，
木鬼利于请西方的医生，
水鬼利于请四散的医生，
火鬼利于请北方的医生，
土鬼利于请东方的医生。
如果前一卦是水鬼、后一卦是火鬼，
先要四散地医治，
最后由北方的医生收功。
en: A Metal ghost favours a doctor from the south,
a Wood ghost a doctor from the west,
a Water ghost doctors from all quarters,
a Fire ghost a doctor from the north,
an Earth ghost a doctor from the east.
If the earlier hexagram is a Water ghost and the later a Fire ghost,
one must first treat with doctors from all quarters,
and the work is completed at the end by a doctor from the north.

dispute.yi: 请医生要往哪个方向请，几家不同。天玄赋注（LY.ILL.TXF.13）按鬼的五行取克它的方位：金鬼利南方（火克金）、木鬼利西方（金克木）、火鬼利北方（水克火）、土鬼利东方（木克土），水鬼利四散（土克水，土没有定方）；火珠林（见 LY.ILL.HZL.09）大体同此说，只有水鬼一项作「利土值」；增删卜易（LY.ILL.ZS.34）则是往「子孙」所在的方位请（午火子孙请南方的医生），子孙休囚空破时看应爻所在的方位，再有独发生用神的爻取那个爻的方位——一个按官鬼的克星取方位，一个按子孙或应爻取方位，书里没有裁决。
dispute.en: In which direction to call the doctor, the books differ. The commentary on the Tianxuan Fu (LY.ILL.TXF.13) takes the direction that controls the phase of the ghost: a Metal ghost favours the south (Fire controls Metal), a Wood ghost the west (Metal controls Wood), a Fire ghost the north (Water controls Fire), an Earth ghost the east (Wood controls Earth), and a Water ghost favours all quarters (Earth controls Water, and Earth has no fixed direction); the Huozhu Lin (see LY.ILL.HZL.09) says much the same, only for the Water ghost it has 'favoured by the earth quarter'; the Zengshan Buyi (LY.ILL.ZS.34) calls the doctor from the direction of Output instead (Wu Fire Output, a doctor from the south), and when Output is resting, trapped, Void or broken looks at the direction of the Other line, and further takes the direction of a line that moves alone and generates the Subject — one takes the direction from what controls the ghost, the other from Output or the Other line, and the books do not settle it.

note.yi: 这一节是「五行用药」和「五行请医的方位」。用药：火鬼凉剂、水鬼温剂丸药、木鬼针、金鬼灸、土鬼剉散——和易隐「医药·治法与用药」（LY.ILL.YY.25：官鬼属金宜灸、属木宜针、属水宜温药丸药、属火宜凉药汤药、属土宜咬咀）一致，「剉散」和「咬咀」都是把药切碎捣散的剂型。「火鬼月建旺宜大寒之剂」的「月建旺」是火鬼旺在当月；这条和黄金策（LY.ILL.HJC.76）「火鬼生旺遇生扶用大寒药、休囚死绝用凉药」是同一句。请医方位：金鬼利南方、木鬼利西方、火鬼利北方、土鬼利东方，正是各自的克星方位；水鬼「利四散」是水的克星土没有固定方位（中央）。「前卦水鬼、后卦火鬼，先须四散医治，终于北方医人收功」是说两次占卜先水鬼（先请四面的医生），后火鬼（最后北方的医生才收功）。 卜筮大全的这一章后面还有「虎易评注」（今人加的），本库不引。
note.en: This section is 'medicine by the five phases' and 'the direction to call a doctor by the five phases'. Medicine: a Fire ghost cooling remedies, a Water ghost warming remedies and pills, a Wood ghost the needle, a Metal ghost moxa, an Earth ghost cut-and-ground powders — the same as the Yi Yin's 'medicine: treatment and the use of medicine' (LY.ILL.YY.25: a Metal Pressure line suits moxa, Wood the needle, Water warming medicine and pills, Fire cooling medicine and decoctions, Earth crushing and grinding); 'cut-and-ground powders' and 'crushing and grinding' are both forms of medicine cut fine and ground to a powder. The 'strong on the Month' of 'a Fire ghost strong on the Month suits very cold remedies' is the Fire ghost strong in the current month; this is the same sentence as the Huangjin Ce's (LY.ILL.HJC.76, 'a Fire ghost in a strong place and helped is treated with very cold medicines, resting, trapped, dead or in Extinction with cooling medicines'). The direction for calling a doctor: a Metal ghost favours the south, Wood the west, Fire the north, Earth the east, which is exactly the direction of what controls each; a Water ghost 'favours all quarters' because Earth, which controls Water, has no fixed direction (it is the centre). 'The earlier hexagram a Water ghost and the later a Fire ghost: first treat with doctors from all quarters, and the work is completed by a doctor from the north' says that of the two divinations the Water ghost comes first (call doctors from all sides first) and the Fire ghost after (a doctor from the north finally completes it). After this chapter the Buyi Daquan also has 'Huyi's commentary' (added by a modern hand), which this library does not quote.

units.title: 卦爻安静为吉、土杀俱兴为凶：占病六爻安静其病可治，吉神常少凶杀常多、吉凶悔吝皆出乎动、动则成咎；六亲中子孙动者吉、六神中青龙动者吉，余者未必皆凶也不能为福，不如安静，有吉神当权自能为福；土杀即辰戌丑未，占病逢之多凶少吉；诸煞见后凶煞章，有一件动便成凶咎

rule.yi: 卦爻安静，重（zhòng）为济世之人；土杀一齐兴动，一定成了黄泉的客人。注说：占病，六爻安静就吉，病可以治；一卦之中凶杀常常多，而吉神常常少，吉凶悔吝都出自动，动就成咎。比如六亲之中，不过子孙动的吉；六神之中，不过青龙动的吉；其余的未必都是凶，也不能成为福，发动对我有什么益处呢？这是吉少凶多。不如卦爻安静，虽然有凶煞，终究没有遭到伤害；如果有吉神当权，自然能为福。土杀就是辰、戌、丑、未，交相变换，运行在四季之间，占病遇上它，多凶少吉。所有诸煞都见后面的凶煞章；如果有一件发动，就成了凶咎。
rule.en: With the hexagram and lines still, weighty is he who saves the world; with Earth and the killings both rising, he is sure to be a guest of the Yellow Springs. The commentary says: in divining illness, six lines still is auspicious and the illness can be treated; in a hexagram the malign killings are often many and the lucky spirits often few; good and ill, regret and shame all come out of movement, and movement makes blame. For example, among the six relations only Output moving is auspicious; among the six spirits only the Azure Dragon moving is auspicious; the rest are not all ominous but cannot make blessing either, and what use to me is their moving? That is little good and much ill. Better that the hexagram and lines be still: though there are malign killings, in the end no harm is done; if a lucky spirit holds power, it can of itself make blessing. The Earth killings are Chen, Xu, Chou and Wei, changing in turn and moving through the four seasons; met in divining illness they are mostly ill and little good. All the killings are given in the later chapter on malign killings; if one of them moves, it makes blame.

yi: 卦爻安静，
重（zhòng）为济世之人；
土杀一起兴动，
一定成了黄泉的客人。
en: With the hexagram and lines still,
weighty is he who saves the world;
with Earth and the killings both rising,
he is sure to be a guest of the Yellow Springs.

yi: 凡是占病，
六爻安静为吉，
病可以治。
一卦之中凶杀常常多，
而吉神常常少；
吉凶悔吝，
都出自动，
动就成咎。
en: In divining illness,
six lines still is auspicious,
and the illness can be treated.
In a hexagram the malign killings are often many,
and the lucky spirits often few;
good and ill, regret and shame,
all come out of movement,
and movement makes blame.

zh: 且如六亲之中，不过子孙动者吉；
六神之中，不过青龙动者吉。
余者未必皆凶，亦不能为福，
不如卦爻安静，虽有凶煞，终未遭伤。
若有吉神当权，自能为福。
交相换易，行乎四时之间，
yi: 比如六亲之中，不过子孙动的吉；
六神之中，不过青龙动的吉。
其余的未必都是凶，也不能成为福，
发动对我有什么益处呢？
这是吉少凶多。
不如卦爻安静，虽然有凶煞，终究没有遭到伤害；
如果有吉神当权，自然能为福。
土杀就是辰、戌、丑、未，
交相变换，运行在四季之间，
占病遇上它，多凶少吉。
en: For example, among the six relations only Output moving is auspicious;
among the six spirits only the Azure Dragon moving is auspicious.
The rest are not all ominous but cannot make blessing either,
and what use to me is their moving?
That is little good and much ill.
Better that the hexagram and lines be still: though there are malign killings, in the end no harm is done;
if a lucky spirit holds power, it can of itself make blessing.
The Earth killings are Chen, Xu, Chou and Wei,
changing in turn and moving through the four seasons;
met in divining illness they are mostly ill and little good.

yi: 所有诸煞，
都见后面的凶煞章。
如果有一件发动，
就成了凶咎。
en: All the killings
are given in the later chapter on malign killings;
if one of them moves,
it makes blame.

note.yi: 这一节是天玄赋疾病章的收尾：占病「安静为吉」——因为「吉少凶多」，一发动多半成咎；吉神里只有子孙动、青龙动才算吉，其余动了未必凶但也不成福，所以不如静。「土杀」指辰戌丑未。「重为济世之人」的「重」按上下文读作重（zhòng，有分量、当得起），意思是六爻安静的病人，是尚能济世（活下去）的人，原文没有解释，这里按字面译作「weighty」；「土煞俱兴，定作黄泉之客」的「土」是丘墓之土（三丘五墓）还是辰戌丑未，注里说是后者（「土杀者，即辰戌丑未」）。这句赋在易冒里也被引过，写作「天元赋」（LY.ILL.YM.12），后面加了「土煞俱兴」的解释。「安静为吉」的说法和野鹤「六爻安静、卦吉可以调理」（LY.ILL.ZS.22）、易冒「卦爻皆静」是同一个判断；和阐奥歌章「疾病章」的「六爻安静尤难瘥」相反——那里说安静反而难愈，书里没有裁决。 卜筮大全的这一章后面还有「虎易评注」（今人加的），本库不引。
note.en: This section closes the Tianxuan Fu's chapter on illness: in divining illness 'still is auspicious' — because 'there is little good and much ill', movement mostly makes blame; among lucky spirits only Output moving and the Azure Dragon moving count as auspicious, and the rest moving are not necessarily ominous but make no blessing, so it is better to be still. 'The Earth killings' are Chen, Xu, Chou and Wei. The 'zhong' of 'weighty is he who saves the world' is read from the context as zhong (weighty, worthy of the burden), and means that a sick person whose six lines are still is one who can still serve the world (live on), which the original does not explain, and it is rendered literally as 'weighty'; whether the 'Earth' of 'Earth and killings both rising, sure to be a guest of the Yellow Springs' is the earth of the mounds and tombs or Chen, Xu, Chou and Wei, the commentary says the latter ('the Earth killings are Chen, Xu, Chou and Wei'). This verse is also quoted in the Yi Mao as 'the Tianyuan Fu' (LY.ILL.YM.12). 'Still is auspicious' is the same judgment as the Old Man of Yehe's 'with six lines still and the hexagram auspicious, it can be treated by nursing' (LY.ILL.ZS.22) and the Yi Mao's 'the hexagram and lines all still'; it is opposite to 'six lines still is harder still to cure' in the chapter on illness of the Chan'ao Gezhang, which says that stillness on the contrary makes it hard to cure, and the books do not settle it. After this chapter the Buyi Daquan also has 'Huyi's commentary' (added by a modern hand), which this library does not quote.
